newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat steady in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat steady in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat prices were steady in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with a slow export market sapping buyers of energy, traders said.

The price paid to farmers in Bahia Blance was unmoved at $129. Cash April maize drifted down $2 to $100 in tepid trade, mainly due to end-of-month technical selling. May soybeans were unchanged at $253 in low volumel. March sunflower seed was steady at $203. Grains trading was generally devoid of big news, and the weather continued to favor developing crops.
